settings.hero_desc: A gold equestrian statue of the UAE's Founding Father on horseback, framed and mounted on a black-and-gold plinth with an engravable nameplate and falcon emblems. A prestigious commemorative award for National Day, VIP recognition and heritage tributes.
settings.s1_body: This commemorative piece honours the UAE's Founding Father as a gold equestrian statue, framed and raised on a black-and-gold plinth finished with falcon emblems and a nameplate ready for engraving. It is a dignified award and heritage gift for National Day ceremonies, government and corporate recognition, and milestone tributes - a symbol of leadership and legacy that recipients display with pride. Available as a single presentation piece or a coordinated set.
settings.case_body: Created as a commemorative tribute to the UAE's Founding Father, this framed gold statue was presented as a VIP award - a dignified, heritage-rich piece that honoured leadership and took pride of place on the recipient's desk.
settings.case_quote: A beautiful, dignified tribute. It was the perfect way to honour our guests on National Day.
settings.prov_p: The best tributes carry meaning. An equestrian statue of the Founding Father turns recognition into a symbol of vision, heritage and leadership that recipients are proud to display.
